interest: Both peers and suffragists welcomed the 1931 defeat of Japan's women's municipal suffrage bill.
overview: File note and report extract on the House of Peers' defeat of the Woman's Civil Rights Bill on March 24, 1931.

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet recording Despatch No. 192 from Japan regarding the defeat of the municipal voting rights bill for women.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Forbes's despatch No. 192 on defeat of municipal votes for women, 1931.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Despatch No. 192 on defeat of Woman's Civil Rights Bill

subfiles.about: A report extract detailing the defeat of the Woman's Civil Rights Bill in the Japanese House of Peers and the reactions of suffragists and opponents.
subfiles.summary: The House of Peers defeated the municipal suffrage bill for women over twenty on March 24, 1931. Suffragists welcomed the defeat as they wanted the full franchise.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic report extract on the defeat of the Woman's Civil Rights Bill in the House of Peers
